title: Multi-Site health summary runtime truth
red: SiteHealthSummaryRuntimeTruthContractTests initially failed because the summary endpoint and clients did not expose the complete pending-runtime contract.
focusedTests: Gateway/DTO/Browser/Desktop contracts passed 4/4; the full targeted Multi-Site regression passed 70/70 with 0 failures and 0 skips
implementation: Health summary resolves active runtime snapshots, excludes pending Sites from current Alert counts, projects pendingRestart and activationStatus per item, reports pendingRestartSites, and presents Thai pending-runtime guidance in Browser and Desktop.
boundary: This module does not activate, mutate, or delete Site configuration. Existing role, CSRF, timeout, database fallback, acknowledgement, external CodeQL, penetration, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode, and production certification boundaries remain unchanged.
